title: Copywriter für E-Mail-Marketing mit Figma-Kenntnissen (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der bei uns Newsletter schreibt und sie gleich fertig baut.
Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.
Wenn du gerade Texte abgibst und danach nie wieder siehst, was daraus geworden ist: Hier ist es ungefähr das Gegenteil.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.
Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt.
Qualifikation

Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
Auge für Ästhetik: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und traust dich an ein Design-Tool.
Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
Du schreibst gut und schnell. Texte, die verkaufen, nicht Texte, die nur schön klingen.
Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten , nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.
Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.
Benefits

Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht

We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

CURRENT EMPLOYEES : Please log into Workday Click Here to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"

Job Description

Do you have at least 7 years of experience doing complex profee surgical coding?
Do you thrive on the challenge of diving into and researching proper codes to assign to a complex surgical procedure?
Then this position may be for you!
The Senior Professional Coder performs at an advanced level medical coding position and serves as an expert utilizing ICD-10 and CPT4 classification system coding to all diagnoses, treatments and procedures in all types of Hospital, Clinic and Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC) locations at stated minimum performance levels. In addition, the Senior Professional Coder provides coding insight and guidance to clinical staff, Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI), Professional Coder 1 and Professional Coder II positions as well as Revenue Cycle leadership.
Key Responsibilities:

• Assign and sequence all ICD-10; CPT 4; Healthcare Common Procedure Coding (HCPC) and modifier codes for services rendered accurately and completely

• Reconcile correct coding edits and discrepancies prior to final coding

• Maintain coding quality of 95% or higher while meeting established productivity requirements based on encounter type

• Follows coding guidelines and legal requirements to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations

• Identify trends in documentation deficiencies and communicates areas of improvement opportunities to leadership and/or providers

• Acts as a key liaison for the physicians and clinical staff as it relates to coding and compliance

• Interacts with physicians and other professional staff of documentation issues relating to coding data

• Acts as a mentor to Coder I and Coder 2 staff

• Provides system and workflow training to newly employed coders

• Prepares and presents education in conjunction with the Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Educator

• Primary contact for Revenue Cycle team throughout Shriners Hospitals for Children (SHC) system to assist with coding questions

• Act as back up for Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Lead

Required Qualifications:

• 7 years of coding experience in inpatient/outpatient professional surgery

• Experience with Surgery Coding guidelines, E/M Coding Guidelines, CPT Coding, ICD-10, Modifiers, HCPCS and CCI edits

• Pediatric, orthopedic and/or injury coding experience

• Experience with education and presentations

• Functional knowledge of Medical Terminology

• Functional knowledge of professional coding practice standards

• Functional knowledge of MS Office

• High School Diploma or GED

• Current CCS-P (AHIMA) or CPC (AAPC)

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Apprentissage statistique et IA générative - CDD de 12 mois

title: Workday Reporting Specialist

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

• Governance, Compliance & Security: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and strict system security/governance across Workday analytics, supporting audit, regulatory compliance, and external benchmarking requirements.

• Process Automation & Continuous Improvement: Lead initiatives to automate recurring workflows, leverage APIs/integrations to enrich reporting datasets, and stay current with Workday releases to continuously improve system capabilities.

• Documentation & Enablement: Develop and maintain detailed documentation for reporting logic, calculated field methodologies, and data definitions; manage hypercare, implementation rollouts, and user adoption across technical levels.

• Leadership & Operational Support: Mentor junior team members on reporting logic and best practices, conduct quality assurance reviews, and efficiently handle ad-hoc analytics and production troubleshooting.

Requirements

• 5-7+ years of experience in Workday Reporting, HR Analytics, or HRIS with increasing responsibility and complexity.

• Advanced experience with Workday Report Writer, EIBs, Calculated Fields, worksheets, and dashboards; Workday PRISM or other

description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring an Analytics Engineer to build and own Cartesia's company-wide source of truth. You'll bring together product, billing, CRM, marketing, and operational data into reliable models and shared metric definitions that teams can trust.

This is an early, foundational data hire. You'll fix urgent correctness issues, strengthen the warehouse and transformation layer, and create the first trusted dashboards for Product, GTM, Growth, RevOps, and leadership. The goal is not simply to answer questions-it is to build the systems, models, and standards that let the company answer them consistently.

YOUR IMPACT

- Own the path from source systems to canonical datasets, metrics, and dashboards.

- Identify and fix data-quality issues across pipelines, models, definitions, and reporting surfaces.

- Build and maintain reliable warehouse models using SQL and dbt or equivalent tooling.

- Establish clear metric definitions, tests, lineage, freshness monitoring, documentation, and ownership.

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, RevOps, Growth, and GTM to translate business concepts into durable data models.

- Create trusted dashboards for core company metrics such as activation, usage, billing, customer health, and marketing performance.

- Make common data questions self-serve while ensuring dashboards reuse canonical logic rather than duplicating it.

- Audit the existing data stack and recommend pragmatic improvements or overhauls to ETL and analytics tooling where needed.

- Educate the company on how to use the source of truth and how new metrics and dashboards should be created.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a technically rigorous analytics role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company.

- Expert SQL and strong warehouse modeling fundamentals, including dimensional modeling, historization, and identity resolution.

- Production experience with dbt or similar transformation tooling, plus testing, orchestration, monitoring, lineage, and documentation.

- A track record of turning fragmented data and competing definitions into canonical, reusable models.

- Experience working across product, billing, CRM, and marketing data; self-serve funnel experience is especially valuable.

- Strong judgment about when a problem belongs in a source system, pipeline, warehouse model, semantic layer, or dashboard.

- The ability to investigate discrepancies end-to-end and prevent them from recurring-not just patch the final report.

- Strong stakeholder instincts and the ability to make ambiguous business concepts precise.

- A practical, low-ego approach: willing to fix urgent issues while building toward a durable foundation.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience as an early or founding member of a data function.

- Experience with full-funnel growth analytics, attribution, channel ROI, CRM, billing, or self-serve conversion.

- Experience building self-serve data workflows or using LLM-powered analytics tooling.

NOT REQUIRED

- Machine learning, predictive modeling, or traditional data science experience. This is an analytics

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - Central
description:

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary

We're looking for a driven Mid-Market Account Executive to join Anaconda 's Sales team and build a strong pipeline across mid-market organizations.

At Anaconda , we're transforming how enterprises harness open-source AI and data science to accelerate innovation. Our Sales team works with organizations already using open-source Python and AI to help them move from free adoption to governed, scalable solutions that drive business outcomes.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle for mid-market opportunities, building relationships with both technical and business stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product to deliver real value at every stage. We value sellers who are curious first-understanding each customer's unique challenges before recommending solutions-collaborative in their approach, accountable for results, and courageous enough to think differently about how AI and open-source create competitive advantage.

What you'll do

• Build and manage a strong pipeline of net-new opportunities within your territory, combining warm leads from existing users with proactive outbound

• Lead discovery conversations that uncover business value-productivity gains, cost reduction, risk mitigation-translating technical capabilities into outcomes that matter to customers

• Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success and Product to identify expansion opportunities and ensure smooth handoff post-close

Your impact will be measured through

• Net-new pipeline created and ARR sourced within your territory

• Win rate and deal velocity on qualified mid-market opportunities

• Customer satisfaction and successful onboarding of new accounts

What "Mid-Market" means at Anaconda

• Organizations with 1,000-10,000 employees

• Selling to buyers across data teams, platform engineering, security, and sometimes procurement-but without the executive complexity of enterprise deals

• Helping customers move from free, open-source adoption to licensed, governed solutions that enable teams to scale safely

• Moving deals with reasonable velocity while maintaining a consultative, value-driven approach and using land-and-expand strategies to grow accounts over time

• Balancing independence as a sales leader without the heavy reliance on Sales Engineering that larger deals require-you own much of the technical conversation

What you need

• 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with demonstrated success closing mid-market deals

title: Associate, Enterprise Change Management
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
At Genesys , we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Department & Team: Enterprise Change Management
Reports to: Clare Robinson
Location: Remote / Virtual (US-Based)
Associate, Enterprise Change Management
Let’s be honest-traditional change management isn’t enough anymore.
AI is changing how work gets done. People and AI are working together in new ways. Technology is moving faster, customer expectations keep evolving, and businesses need to be able to adapt just as quickly.
At Genesys , we think that creates an exciting opportunity to rethink change.
We’re building the next evolution of change -moving beyond managing change one project at a time to creating a connected approach that helps our people and our business continuously adapt and thrive.
That means creating great change experiences for employees, helping leaders confidently lead their teams through change, using AI and data to better understand what people need, and staying focused on whether our work is actually delivering the outcomes we set out to achieve.
We call this the Genesys Way of Change -our modern approach to making transformation happen. It’s human-centered, intelligent, connected, and always evolving. We’re not interested in simply applying yesterday’s change playbooks to tomorrow’s challenges. We want to learn, experiment, use new technology, and find better ways to help people and the business adapt faster and turn change into meaningful results.
As an Associate, Enterprise Change Management , you’ll help bring this vision to life.
Working alongside our Enterprise Change Management team and partners across Genesys , you’ll help create and deliver change experiences that enable our people to understand what’s changing, adapt quickly, and thrive in new ways of working. You’ll help us understand how change is landing, turn data and feedback into insights, experiment with AI and new approaches, and build the tools and practices that will shape how change happens across Genesys .
If you’re curious about people, excited by how AI is changing the workplace, and want to learn how transformation really happens inside a global company, this is an opportunity to help us build what comes next.
What You’ll Do

• Support design/development of change experiences and execute change activities for assigned initiatives or workstreams, coordinating milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables to support successful adoption

• Develop communications, learning materials, engagement activities, presentations, toolkits, change champion networks, and other tactics and activities that help employees understand and adopt new ways of working

• Use AI-enabled tools to increase personal productivity, streamline routine change activities, improve content development, and experiment with more effective ways of delivering change

• Partner with business stakeholders and project teams to keep change deliverables aligned with broader initiative priorities

• Track readiness, employee experience, engagement, adoption, and other relevant metrics to understand change progress, surface insights, and capture lessons learned

• Share ideas, feedback, and lessons learned that improve team practices and contribute to the continued evolution of the Genesys Way of Change

What You’ll Bring

• 2+ years of experience in organizational change management, employee communications, or learning and enablement. Familiarity with established organizational change methodologies, tools, and practices

title: Security SVT
description:
Position Summary

The Product Security Analyst supports NETGEAR's vulnerability management and product security incident response function. This role triages and scores reported vulnerabilities, verifies proof-of-concept exploits against NETGEAR products and services, applies AI-assisted tooling to accelerate security code review, and works with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle to close out findings. The ideal candidate combines hands-on offensive security skills with the judgment to communicate risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• CVSS Scoring & Triage: Score and triage reported vulnerabilities using the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), producing consistent, defensible base, temporal, and environmental scores and prioritizing intake accordingly.

• Vulnerability Verification & PoC Review: Independently verify reported vulnerabilities, reproduce and validate proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit code, and assess real-world exploitability and impact on NETGEAR products and services.

• AI-Assisted Security Analysis: Apply AI-assisted tools and techniques to explore and analyze security issues, including AI-augmented static/dynamic code analysis, to speed up root-cause identification and coverage of complex codebases.

• Penetration Testing Tools: Use a range of penetration testing and security assessment tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, static/dynamic analysis suites) to evaluate firmware, web, cloud, and mobile attack surfaces.

• SDLC Engagement: Partner with engineering throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to embed security requirements, review designs and code, and validate remediations before release.

Required Qualifications

• Solid understanding of CVSS (v3.1 or later) and demonstrated ability to score and prioritize vulnerabilities consistently.

• Hands-on experience reproducing and validating vulnerability reports and proof-of-concept exploits.

• Working knowledge of applying AI/LLM-based tools to security code analysis or vulnerability research.

• Practical familiarity with common penetration testing tools and methodologies (web, network, and/or firmware).

• Experience working within a formal Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including secure design and code review practices.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with embedded/IoT or networking product security (routers, gateways, or similar consumer or enterprise devices).

• Familiarity with vulnerability disclosure processes and coordinated disclosure (PSIRT) workflows.

• Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate triage and verification tasks.

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.  

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. 日本語訳

担当する業務
ClickHouseでは現在、世界中のお客様に優れたサービスを提供するサポートチームを拡大しています。日本国内のお客様はもちろん、APJおよびEMEA地域にまたがるお客様に関する幅広い業務に取り組んでいただける方を探しています。本ポジションはお客様と直接やり取りする職種で、日本国内でのお客様先への訪問も一部含まれます。サポートチケットやコミュニティサポートに加え、プリセールス・ポストセールス双方のお客様向け活動の支援、Go To Marketチームと連携したPOCの高度な技術面への対応、ClickHouseのサポート部門における業務改善の提案など、幅広い業務を主体的に担当していただきます。自ら率先して手を動かし、日本での地域プレゼンスの拡大に貢献したい方にとって、またとない機会です。

参画いただく可能性のあるプロジェクト例

- サポートサービスチーム、エンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメントと緊密に連携し、ユーザーやお客様に必要とされる機能の定義に貢献する

- ClickHouse CloudおよびClickHouseオープンソースをベースとしたソリューションを開発し、ドキュメント、ナレッジベース、ブログ、ミートアップ、ウェビナー、トレーニングを通じて、ユーザー、コミュニティ、お客様と共有する

- 同僚、ユーザー、お客様に対するメンタリングやトレーニング、知識の共有を支援する

そして、もちろん以下も担います

- フロントラインのエンジニア、そしてClickHouseの代表として、優れたカスタマーサービスを提供します。当社のサポートエンジニアは、チケットシステム、メール、Slack、電話などで受け付けた技術的なケースに対し、所定のサービスレベルアグリーメント(「SLA」)の範囲内で、プロフェッショナルな対応、オンコール対応、およびガイダンスを提供します

- 同僚、お客様、パートナーとの間に、強固で信頼できる関係を築きます

求めるスキル・経験

- テクニカルサポート組織での実務経験

- 関連分野における幅広く深い技術力(例:ClickHouse DBMS、または類似のOLAP/SQLデータベース、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォームの経験、Linux/Unixの経験、Kubernetesおよびコンテナの経験、システムまたはネットワーク管理の経験)

- グローバルに分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要な、勤務スケジュールおよび出張(現地訪問)に対応でき、対応可能であること

- 日本語と英語の両方における優れた文章力・会話力

- プリセールス・ポストセールスのサポート、ソリューションエンジニアリングまたはセールスエンジニアリング、コンサルティング、トレーニングなどを伴う、顧客対応職での経験

- チームワーク、グローバルな視点での関わり、共感力、そして困難な課題を解決する姿勢

- 世界で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能かつ最大規模、最速のデータベースを構築することに対する冒険心と切迫感

- 自発的で好奇心旺盛、継続的に学び成長する意欲があること

あればなお歓迎

- ソフトウェア開発者、プロダクトマネージャー、アカウント担当者、ユーザーコミュニティと協力し、素晴らしいユーザー体験・顧客体験を実現した実績

- オープンソースのソフトウェア技術を大規模なデータセットに適用し、複雑な問いを解決して私たちの暮らす世界をより良くしたいという情熱

確認・調整メモ

- 原文の軽微な修正点(英語側): 「locared」は「located」の誤記と解釈しました。また「support team … who provides」は、チームなので「that provides」が自然です。

- 「24x7」: 日本語では「24時間365日」が一般的なため、この表現にしました。原文どおり「24x7」のままにしたい場合はお知らせください。

- 「Be present and available…」: 他の箇条書きが名詞句なのに対し、この項目だけ命令形で並列が崩れています。日本語では「〜に対応でき、対応可能であること」と、他項目に合わせた形にしました。

- 「アカウント担当者」: account representativesの訳です。社内で「アカウントエグゼクティブ」など特定の呼称があれば、それに置き換えてください。

- 敬体について: 「担当する業務」セクションは、ですます調で統一しています。日本語のJDでは一般的な文体です。

 

PERKS

title: VP of Product
description:
About Augintel : We exist to give child welfare leadership and staff a deeper understanding of the people they care for. By building SaaS software applications that apply cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques, we help clinicians in social services, behavioral health and child welfare - government, private and nonprofit - unlock the value of their unstructured data to improve their understanding, save them time, and help them deliver better outcomes to the people and communities they serve.

Location: Remote (US). Ability to support customers across multiple time zones is required.

Reports To: CEO

Job Summary:

Over the last six years Augintel has built a new category in Child Welfare and has transformed how caseworkers and supervisors do their jobs. We’ve been first to market with an industry-defining product, enjoy exceptional customer retention, and continue to win new business. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need to strengthen both our strategic vision as well as our day-to-day execution.

The Chief Product Officer will be the executive responsible for aligning Augintel ’s strategy and product direction and associated operating cadence and cross-functional execution.

This leader will help Augintel maintain the speed and customer intimacy of a founder-led company while building the clarity, accountability, prioritization discipline, and operating infrastructure required for sustainable growth.

At the product level, this leader will own the translation of Augintel ’s vision into a cohesive 12-36 month product strategy and roadmap. They will ensure that new products and features do not simply ship, but land in the market with clear positioning, customer value, adoption plans, enablement, and measurable revenue impact.

At the operating level, this leader will build the company-wide rhythms that connect annual strategy to quarterly execution, commitments to operating plans, and customer commitments to product, engineering, and commercial capacity.

The right person is both strategic and hands-on. They can articulate a compelling multi-year product vision, but they also care deeply about roadmap discipline, prioritization, launch quality, customer feedback loops, commercial enablement, financial outcomes, and execution predictability.

The ideal candidate thrives in founder-led organizations transitioning from early-stage success to operational maturity. They excel at balancing customer commitments with long-term strategic investments and are energized by solving complex scaling challenges.

This is a role for a builder, operator, product strategist, and trusted CEO partner. This role is part of the executive team and reports to the CEO.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Operating Rhythm & Execution

• Translate annual strategic product objectives into measurable quarterly execution

• Lead company-wide planning processes, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and operating reviews

• Establish and maintain a consistent cadence of product and go-to-market execution and accountability across the organization

• Monitor progress against company objectives and proactively identify execution risks

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

• Own Augintel ’s product strategy in partnership with the CEO, Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Customer Impact

• Translate CEO vision and market insight into a cohesive 12-36 month product roadmap

• Balance near-term customer commitments with long-term strategic product investments

• Ensure roadmap decisions are grounded in customer value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and time-to-market

• Establish clear prioritization frameworks that guide what Augintel starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes

• Elevate product discovery, customer understanding, design discipline, experimentation, and product decision-making across the company

• Represent Product at the executive and board level

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research, World Action Model

Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. title: Trendyol Express - Bölge Yöneticisi/Diyarbakır
description:
Ekip Hakkında
Trendyol Express ekibi olarak amacımız, her siparişte müşterilerimize kusursuz bir teslimat deneyimi sunmaktır. Müşteriyi her zaman odağımıza alarak; en ileri teknolojiyi, esnek operasyonel altyapıyı ve yenilikçi çözümleri bir araya getiriyoruz.
 
Hızlı ve iş birliğine dayalı çalışma kültürümüz sayesinde; veri, çeviklik ve güçlü ekip ruhu ile her zorluğu fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Bölgesel olarak büyürken, lojistikte yeni standartlar belirliyor ve attığımız her adımda kalıcı değer yaratmak için çalışıyoruz.

Pozisyon Hakkında
Bu rol, temel olarak bir Bölge Yöneticisi (Area Executive) pozisyonu olup; Trendyol Express bünyesinde belirli bir bölgedeki tüm lojistik ağının, dağıtım merkezlerinin (hub) ve kurye operasyonlarının denetlenmesinden sorumludur.
Kısacası ana misyon; bölgesel teslimat hedeflerine ve KPI'lara ulaşmak, yeni dağıtım merkezleri keşfedip sürücü/kurye ağını genişleterek operasyonel verimliliği artırmak ve yasal düzenlemelere tam uyum içinde ekiplere liderlik etmektir. Stratejik planlama ile sahadaki birebir uygulamayı birbirine bağlayan; kritik, analitik odaklı ve liderlik vizyonu gerektiren bir pozisyondur.

Trendyol’da Sizi Neler Bekliyor?
- FlexBenefits: Günlük yemek bütçeni özelleştirebilir, sağlık sigortanı upgrade edebilir, akaryakıt desteği veya Trendyol alışveriş bakiyesi gibi ek haklar arasından ihtiyacına göre seçim yapabilirsin.
- İyi yaşam desteği: Lokasyon bazlı kurum içi doktorlarımızdan, psikolog ve diyetisyen desteğinden ve HPV aşısı kapsamından faydalanabilirsin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatları: Yıllık eğitim bütçeni ihtiyacana uygun olduğunu düşündüğün eğitim veya konferans için kullanabilirsin. LMS platformumuzdan dilediğin an faydalanabilir, yıl boyu sunulan yüz yüze eğitimlere katılabilirsin.
- İlk günden sorumluluk alma kültürü: Trendyol’da her ses duyulur ve değer görür. Sen de daha ilk günden itibaren inisiyatif alarak etki yaratabilirsin.
- Tek ruhlu, çok kültürlü bir ekip: Berlin’den Dubai’ye, Amsterdam’dan İstanbul’a... Farklı bakış açılarını bir araya getiren, start-up ruhuyla çalışan uluslararası bir ekibiz.
- En iyilerle birlikte gelişme imkânı: Anlamlı işlerde sorumluluk alabilir, deneyimleyerek öğrenebilirsin. Farklı ülkelerdeki ekip arkadaşlarımızdan mentorluk alabilir ve alanında uzman ekip arkadaşlarımızla birlikte kendini geliştirebilirsin.
- İş dışında da anlamlı bağlar: Ekip ritüelleri, etkinlikler ve sosyal aktiviteler sayesinde yalnızca birlikte çalışmıyor; birlikte gülüyor, öğreniyor ve ilham alıyoruz.
 
Kariyerinde Bir Sonraki Adıma Geçmek İstersen;
Bu rol seni heyecanlandırdıysa hemen başvur, bir sonraki adımı birlikte atalım.
Ekibi daha yakından tanımak mı istiyorsun?
Kariyer Sitemizi, LinkedIn sayfamızı veya YouTube kanalımızı ziyaret ederek #LifeatTrendyol ve çalışma şeklimiz hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinebilirsin.

title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. - 7-8 years of industry experience with 5+ years in pre-sales

- Outstanding presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences

- Strong ability to connect business problems with technical solutions

- Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or related field

Join a team of customer-obsessed Solution Engineers who are passionate about making clients successful. title: Data Engineer
description:
ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions-and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare-and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Solace, we are building the data foundation that will power patient outcomes. We are a small but growing team where everyone wears many hats and moves fast. We are looking for a Data Engineer who loves solving hard problems with clean, maintainable code and thrives in this high-growth startup environment.

In this role, you will architect the infrastructure that allows us to scale. You will be a core builder of our data platform, establishing the frameworks, standards, and best practices that will define our engineering culture for years to come. From raw data ingestion to complex modeling, your work will ensure that our data is not just available, but trusted, reliable, and ready for action. You'll also help own the FastAPI data API that puts that data to work inside our application, powering data-driven decisions for our users.

- Optimize Data Models: Collaborate with analysts to design performant SQL transformations and data models in Snowflake (experience with dbt is a huge plus).

- Ensure Data Reliability: Implement observability and monitoring to catch issues before they impact stakeholders. You are the first line of defense for data quality.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Data Analysts and Product Managers to understand their data needs and deliver high-quality data products that empower decision-making.

- Own Our Data API: We run a data API built on FastAPI that drives data-driven decisions within the application. You'll help own it and everything that comes with it, including endpoint design, performance, deployment, monitoring, and reliability for the product teams that depend on it.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- Strong Python Proficiency: You are comfortable writing modular, testable, and efficient Python code for data processing and automation.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

title: Program Manager

MarketSource is a sales acceleration company focused on delivering better outcomes for many of the world’s most iconic brands. We design, operationalize, and execute managed sales and customer experience solutions for companies in B2B and B2C environments.
Our solutions are purpose-built and tech-enabled to deliver measurable improvements in business outcomes. We live by a set of people-focused values that guide our relationships with each other and with our clients. By putting people first, working together to make others successful, and establishing a rich and empowered work culture, we create opportunities for our people and the businesses we serve to be successful.
Responsibilities
Summary
The Program Manager focuses on building and leading a highly motivated program supporting our client(s). This role is responsible for collaborating to create a process that will drive expectations within a specified account base. The Program Manager hires, coaches, trains, develops, and mentors their team, executes market and account plans, collects real-time account information, partners with the client to drive innovation and value, and ultimately drives business results. 
Essential Job Functions:

• Plan and direct the program’s activities to achieve financial and performance targets mutually established by MarketSource and the client

• Direct functions and performance within the program, including oversight and monitoring of employee activity

• Manage client commitments and expectations

• Monitor Program objectives and provide critical performance feedback to the client and leadership

• Coach and develop team members to drive performance and exceed program goals and objectives

• Develop and implement processes to measures and drive performance

• Provide analysis for ad-hoc executive management reporting

title: Staff Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Motor Control Algorithm Development
•       Design and implement field-oriented control (FOC), six-step commutation, and direct torque control algorithms for BLDC and PMSM motors
•       Develop sensorless rotor position estimation techniques (back-EMF observer, sliding-mode observer, high-frequency injection) for applications where Hall sensors or encoders are not viable
•       Design current, speed, and position control loops with rigorous bandwidth, stability margins, and disturbance rejection specifications
Modelling & Simulation (MIL / SIL / HIL)
•       Build high-fidelity motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB / Simulink, including magnetic saturation, iron losses, and thermal coupling
•       Develop controller models and validate performance through Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) simulation against requirements
•       Execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing using Embedded Coder auto-generated C code to verify fixed-point scaling, quantisation effects, and code-generation fidelity
•       Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators (dSPACE, Typhoon HIL, or equivalent) for full controller board validation
•       Integrate Simulink auto-coded algorithm modules with the microcontroller RTOS, peripheral drivers, and application framework
Firmware & Embedded Systems
•       Implement motor control firmware in C on microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, TI C2000, NXP S32K) with hard real-time constraints
•       Configure and optimise motor control peripherals: PWM timers, ADC synchronisation, encoder/Hall interfaces, comparator-based overcurrent protection
•       Architect firmware for deterministic control loop execution - interrupt prioritisation, DMA pipelines, and minimal-jitter scheduling
•       Implement fault detection, diagnosis, and safe-state management in firmware (overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, sensor loss, stall, phase loss)
•       Develop communication interfaces (CAN, SPI, UART, RS-485) for command, telemetry, and diagnostics

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience
•       10+ years of professional experience designing and implementing motor control algorithms (FOC, Trapezoidal, or equivalent) for BLDC or PMSM motors
•       Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory - PID tuning, frequency-domain analysis, state estimation, observer design
•       Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink, PLEC

description:
Senior Community Manager

ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE - built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the reason tenants feel like they belong to something. Not just a building, but a community - one with its own energy, its own rituals, and a sense that someone actually cares about how their days go.

As a Senior Community Manager, you design and oversee the full tenant programming experience: from the annual event calendar to day-of execution, from building communications to the tenant app. You lead the team that brings it all to life, and you're accountable for the engagement numbers that show it's working.

This role requires the creativity to design programs people actually want to attend, the operational discipline to run them well, and the relationship skills to make tenants feel personally connected to the building. The programming is the vehicle. The feeling is the product.

At buildings where this role works well, tenants renew leases partly because of what you've built. That's the bar.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants show up. Event attendance is strong, app engagement is growing, and the building has a reputation for actually doing things worth coming to.

• Tenant relationships feel personal. People know your name, tell you things, and trust that you'll follow through.

• Building communications are consistent, on-brand, and actually read. The app, signage, and newsletter work together as one voice.

• NPS and tenant satisfaction scores are trending upward, and you can trace them back to specific programs and decisions.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You get energy from making people feel seen and connected. It's not just about organizing events. It's about noticing who's new, who needs an introduction, who's been having a rough week - and doing something about it.

• You're equally comfortable with strategy and execution. You can think through a quarterly programming calendar and then personally staff a Thursday afternoon activation. Both feel important to you.

• You understand that community doesn't happen by accident. You've built programs that worked and ones that didn't, and you learned from both. You have a framework for what drives engagement and why.

• You lead through relationships, not authority. Your direct reports work hard because they want to, not because you've told them to. You invest in people and it shows.

• You're genuinely curious about your tenants. You know what companies are in your building, what they're working on, what they care about. That knowledge makes your programming better and your relationships stickier.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather stay behind the scenes than be the face of a program. This role requires daily visibility and genuine warmth in person.

• You find the detail work (signage, supply checks, survey follow-up) more frustrating than fulfilling.

• Predictable routines appeal to you more than dynamic, fast-moving days.

• People management (coaching, feedback, performance conversations) feels like a distraction from your real work. Here, it is part of your real work.

• You don't see community programming as central to building value. Here, it's one of the primary drivers of tenant retention.

WHAT YOU OWN

Community programming and building communications:

• Design and execute a dynamic calendar of tenant events focused on values that build community and engagement.

• Manage all aspects of community events including budgeting, vendor management, onsite execution, and reporting.

• Manage event marketing including updating the tenant app, digital and physical signage, and the buildin

title: [MSO] Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer (Ansible)
description:
Project - the aim you’ll have
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer to help build an automation practice for a leading IT infrastructure provider in the Netherlands.

Automation is already being done, but it has grown in several directions at once - different approaches, different standards and different repository layouts running in parallel. A large part of this role is bringing that together into one practice the whole team works with.

You will join a 12+ person Polish engineering team responsible for maintaining the client's Linux and Windows estate and for delivering transformation projects on it. The environment carries a significant legacy footprint, built up over years of operations. At the same time we are building a completely new platform based on OpenStack, so the automation you create will cover both: keeping the existing estate running, and making sure the new platform is automated from day one rather than years later.

You will also have a software development team as a help, so when something needs to be properly engineered rather than scripted around, you will not be solving it alone.

Your first deliverable is continuous patching across Linux and Windows - moving the client from scheduled manual patching cycles to an automated, continuously running process. From there the practice expands into deployment automation, configuration management and process automation across the estate.
Role - how you’ll contribute

• Writing Ansible automation - playbooks, roles, modules and collections - this is the core, day-to-day work of the role

• Help shape the automation practice: standards, repository structure and code review process, worked out together with the team

• Patch management automation

• Deployment automation

• Configuration management

• Systems and process automation

• Project-driven infrastructure transformations - bring automation into the transformation projects the team delivers, so that what is built new is automated from the start

• Support, configure and manage the automation platform

• Automation-related code review and maintenance across the team

• CI/CD configuration and management for automation code

• Define and maintain the inventory and source of truth the automation runs against

• Introduce testing for automation code, so changes can be released to a production estate with confidence

• Work with engineers maintaining the estate to identify what should be automated next, and in what order

• Share knowledge with the team so the practice is something everyone can work with

• Produce and maintain the technical documentation that makes the practice usable by others

Expectations - the experience you need

• Advanced knowledge and experience in using, configuring and maintaining automation platforms, preferably AAP/AWX

• Understanding best practices for writing and maintaining Ansible code and repositories

• Developing Ansible playbooks, roles and modules; maintaining Ansible collections

• Using Ansible to manage systems and processes at scale

• Advanced understanding of IaC principles

• Practical experience with patch management across both Linux and Windows systems

• Experience working across various Linux distributions

• Programming skills, preferably Python

• Solid Git and version control practice applied to automation code

• Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation

• English at C1 level - the working language with the client, including direct contact with client-side engineers and stakeholders

Additional skills - the edge you have

• OpenStack - we are building a new platform on it, so experience here is a strong plus

• Experience consolidating scattered automation into a single, consistent practice

• Experience setting technical standards and getting a team to adopt them

• Good understanding of virtualization concepts

• Puppet - part of the current estate, and consolidating it into Ansible is within the scope of this rol
